seg.seg_note: Two reportable segments: MIS (CFG, SFG, FIG, PPIF, MIS Other) and MA (RD&A, ERS, PS; MAKS/Copal Amba aggregated into MA and reported in PS). All segment items (LOB revenue, intersegment royalty/revenue, segment Adjusted Operating Income, D&A, restructuring, segment operating income) from the release Table 2 / Table 6 (three-month columns). mis_recurring / mis_transaction and ma_recurring / ma_transaction = release Table 7 'Relationship' / 'Transaction' revenue (external). elim = Table 6 total eliminations (MIS royalty + MA intersegment revenue). Segment Adjusted Operating Income includes intersegment revenue and expense. us_rev / intl_rev = consolidated 'United States' / 'International' (Table 2). Q4 three-month segment table has no restructuring row (mis_restr/ma_restr null; FY restructuring was all in Q1-Q3).

ngaap.notes: Adjusted operating income = operating income excluding depreciation and amortization, restructuring and settlement charges. Adjusted net income / Adjusted EPS (Table 11): 'exclude a restructuring and settlement charge, a foreign exchange gain related to a subsidiary liquidation and a Legacy Tax benefit as well as the income tax effects of these items'. Settlement charge per share: pre-tax 4.47, tax (0.84), net 3.63; tax on settlement charge (163.1). Adjusted operating expense (Table 9) = 551.4 (total expenses less settlement charge). Free cash flow = net cash provided by operating activities minus payments for capital additions. FCF published only for FY (1,110.9; see annual record).

notes: Settlement charge 863.8 = agreement with the U.S. DOJ and attorneys general of 21 states + DC (announced 13-Jan-2017) on crisis-era structured finance ratings; charged to MIS; paid in Q1-17. Other non-operating income 41.6 includes ~35 (34.8) FX gain on liquidation of a subsidiary (non-GAAP item). eps_d -2.22 as printed in the Q4-16 release; the 2016 10-K quarterly data, the Q4-17 release and XBRL show Q4-16 diluted EPS (2.25) (antidilution in a loss quarter). Mismatch vs XBRL noted. Q4-17 release recast Q4-16 adjusted NI to 243.5 and adjusted EPS to 1.26 (adds amortization 8.7/6.2 and a +0.03 'adjustment to include dilutive effect of equity compensation awards'). dps_decl from the 2016 10-K dividends table (declared Q4 0.75 = two quarterly dividends of 0.37 and 0.38).
